parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test files: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/AppConfigurationTests.swift' (package: AppServices) and 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceHTTPTests.swift' (package: Metadata). Although the context_flags do not set is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both type-alias-object declarations inside test targets (the 'Tests/' directory segment and '*Tests.swift' naming convention). Each test package defines its own local MockURLProtocol alias as a test fixture scoped to that package's needs; consolidating them would couple two otherwise independent test targets and risk leaking test infrastructure across package boundaries. No shared production code is involved, so no-action is the correct recommendation.
